description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeePictureController class within the OrangeHRM framework. It handles HTTP requests related to employee pictures, including retrieving employee photos and serving default images if no specific picture is available. The class utilizes services for fetching employee picture data, sets appropriate HTTP headers, and manages cache validation through ETags.

classes.name: EmployeePictureController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling employee picture retrieval and response generation within the OrangeHRM framework.

methods.name: getEmployeePictureService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeePictureService instance used for fetching employee picture data.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming HTTP request to serve the employee's picture, handling cache validation via ETags, and falls back to a default image if necessary.

methods.name: setCommonHeaders
methods.description: Sets common HTTP headers on the response, including content type, cache directives, and privacy settings.
